name: strike of the giants

prerequisites.desc: Proficiency with a martial weapon or Giant Foundling background

desc: You’ve learned to imbue your weapon strikes with the power of giants. When you take this feat, choose one of the following strike types: Cloud Strike, Fire Strike, Frost Strike, Hill Strike, Stone Strike, or Storm Strike.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack or a ranged weapon attack using a thrown weapon, you can apply the chosen strike’s effect to the target. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
